objectives.en: Describe the five groups of protists with examples

narration.en: Sometimes the sea turns red and fish die in thousands. The culprit is a single-celled protist called Gonyaulax.
narration.kn: ಕೆಲವೊಮ್ಮೆ ಸಮುದ್ರ ಕೆಂಪಾಗಿ ಸಾವಿರಾರು ಮೀನುಗಳು ಸಾಯುತ್ತವೆ. ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣ ಗೋನಿಯಾಲಾಕ್ಸ್ ಎಂಬ ಏಕಕೋಶ ಪ್ರೊಟಿಸ್ಟ್.

body.en: All single-celled eukaryotes are placed in Protista. Chrysophytes include diatoms and desmids; diatoms have silica walls that pile up as diatomaceous earth and are the chief producers in the oceans. Dinoflagellates are mostly marine with stiff cellulose plates and two flagella; Gonyaulax causes red tides. Euglenoids like Euglena have a protein-rich pellicle instead of a cell wall and are photosynthetic in light but heterotrophic in the dark.
body.kn: ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಏಕಕೋಶ ಯೂಕ್ಯಾರಿಯೋಟ್‌ಗಳು ಪ್ರೊಟಿಸ್ಟಾ. ಡಯಾಟಮ್‌ಗಳ ಸಿಲಿಕಾ ಭಿತ್ತಿಗಳು ಡಯಾಟಮ ಮಣ್ಣಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಗೋನಿಯಾಲಾಕ್ಸ್ ಕೆಂಪು ಅಲೆ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಯೂಗ್ಲೀನಾದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರೋಟೀನ್‌ಯುಕ್ತ ಪೆಲಿಕಲ್ ಇದೆ.

say.en: Kingdom Protista holds all single-celled eukaryotes.
Chrysophytes include diatoms with silica walls; dinoflagellates like Gonyaulax cause red tides.
Euglenoids have a pellicle; they photosynthesise in light and feed in the dark.
Slime moulds form a plasmodium and, in bad times, tough spores.
Protozoans are heterotrophs: amoeboid, flagellated, ciliated and sporozoans.

narration.en: Four groups of protists. Sort each organism or feature.

prompt.en: Place each protist or feature in its group.
prompt.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಪ್ರೋಟಿಸ್ಟ್ ಅಥವಾ ಲಕ್ಷಣವನ್ನು ಅದರ ಗುಂಪಿಗೆ ಸೇರಿಸಿ.

text.en: Diatoms with silica walls that form diatomaceous earth
Two flagella: one along the body, one across it
Euglena: a protein-rich pellicle instead of a cell wall
Photosynthetic in light, heterotrophic in the dark

explanation.en: Chrysophytes are the chief producers in oceans; dinoflagellates are mostly marine with stiff cellulose plates; euglenoids live in fresh water; protozoans are heterotrophs, as predators or parasites.

body.en: Slime moulds are saprophytes; under suitable conditions they form a plasmodium, and in bad conditions they make spores with true walls that survive for years. Protozoans are heterotrophs: amoeboid (Amoeba, Entamoeba), flagellated (Trypanosoma, causing sleeping sickness), ciliated (Paramoecium, with a gullet) and sporozoans (Plasmodium, causing malaria).
body.kn: ಲೋಳೆ ಬೂಷ್ಟುಗಳು ಕೊಳೆತಿನಿಗಳು; ಪ್ಲಾಸ್ಮೋಡಿಯಂ ರೂಪಿಸುತ್ತವೆ. ಪ್ರೊಟೊಜೋವಾಗಳು ಪರಪೋಷಿಗಳು: ಅಮೀಬಾಯ್ಡ್, ಕಶಾಂಗಿ (ಟ್ರಿಪನೋಸೋಮ), ಸೀಲಿಯೇಟ್ (ಪ್ಯಾರಮೀಸಿಯಂ), ಸ್ಪೊರೋಜೋವಾ (ಪ್ಲಾಸ್ಮೋಡಿಯಂ).

problem.en: A protist has two flagella, chloroplasts and no cell wall but a flexible pellicle. In the dark it feeds on other small organisms. Identify the group and an example.

steps.en: A pellicle instead of a cell wall points to euglenoids.
Photosynthesis in light but heterotrophy in the dark is typical of Euglena.
So it is a euglenoid, example Euglena.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. A protist has two flagella, chloroplasts and no cell wall but a flexible pellicle. In the dark it feeds on other small organisms. Identify the group and an example.

body.en: Amoeboid move by pseudopodia, flagellated by flagella, ciliated by cilia, and sporozoans have an infectious spore-like stage.

narration.en: Protozoan groups by movement. Amoeboid move by pseudopodia, flagellated by flagella, ciliated by cilia, and sporozoans have an infectious spore-like stage.
